offer.message: Taylor, buddy, you're 0-6 and burying Amon-Ra St. Brown behind Puka Nacua like it doesn't matter who starts there — I'm doing you a favor here, giving you a name you can actually say out loud on offense while I take the guy rotting on your bench. Keenan Allen's a vet, he's steady, he fits that character-over-talent thing you keep selling. Take it before I stop being nice about it.

Tony, honey, I'll send you Deshaun Watson — a man I benched Drake Maye FOR, so you know he's got range — plus Mike Evans, who is apparently allergic to the end zone this month, and in exchange you hand me Caleb Williams. Not because I need him. Because you love him like he's your last Game 7, and I want to see your face when you say no. We'll see who really wants to win.
